item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, wide editorial composition. A single elegant smoked amber glass candle vessel with creamy ivory wax and a small graceful flame, on a warm ivory travertine pedestal. Unbranded vessel, no lettering or text. A matching dark brushed brass lid resting beside the vessel, a subtle curl of smoke, one understated botanical sprig suggesting a refined woody fragrance. Warm directional studio light, soft sculptural shadows, restrained cream, amber and bronze palette, tactile natural stone backdrop, immaculate styling, realistic glass reflections and wax texture, sophisticated high-end fragrance campaign, generous negative space, hero product in sharp focus, photorealistic.
